items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I don't know him much. ... I didn't even know George Rush till I met him on here. ... I didn't know anything about him.

ctx.x: And I said how come you used him, I thought Henry Martin was your drummer. He said well, something funny, like he said Henry Martin wanted to take up guitar, he said he played guitar and dropped his drums for a while, something like that.
So I guess that's it. He did use, he used Johnny Lindsey, I think it was.
Joe. Joe Lindsey. Johnny was the bass player.
